mentions.name: Lettered
mentions.description: A daily puzzle game with shareable replay GIFs. The author is experimenting with generating good-looking replays using gifenc without sacrificing file size for quality.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a daily puzzle game called https://lettered.io and I’ve been playing around with shareable replay gifs via gifenc. It’s been fun trying to get good looking replays without sacrificing size for quality
